title: Landing page for a SaaS product
request: Build a landing page for Northstar, a tool that turns customer interviews into product decisions. It needs a strong hero, a few reasons to believe, social proof, and one clear sign-up call to action at the end.
rubric: Does this read like a real SaaS landing page: a hero that says what Northstar does, reasons to believe, proof, and one closing call to action — rather than a single generic section?
why: The canonical request. A page built from one block is technically valid and commercially useless, which is exactly the difference no unit test in packages/builder/ai can currently see.
